I develop digital services for [Iltalehti.fi](https://il.fi), Finland's largest digital news platform serving 3+ million weekly users. Working across our entire digital ecosystem, I create both user-facing features and internal tools that empower our newsroom.

Key achievements:

- Developed front-end implementation of award-winning AI sentiment analysis tool that won first place at the INMA Global Media Awards 2024, with other category winners including Washington Post and Daily Mail
- Led React v16 → v18 migration, enabling SSR streaming and improving page load performance and developer experience across the platform
- Played a key role in architecting and launching "Paras Sää" weather section rebuild, creating a more responsive, feature-rich experience
- Implemented Google Extended Access authentication, extending our Ruby backend to verify Google's signing keys and serve Plus articles to eligible users
- Developed journalist productivity tools, including a dynamic calculator embed, a poll embed, and improvements to a news tip embed.

Beyond coding, I actively shape our engineering culture:

- Delivered presentations at Alma Media's trainee program kickoffs (2024 and 2025), while regularly presenting at engineering demos.

Tech: TypeScript, React 18, Node.js, Ruby (backend contributions), SSR, Redux, AI Integration
